message:
Merge pull request #263 from joho/ci-and-versioning-updates-may-26

CI and Versioning updates

pr.title: CI and Versioning updates
pr.body:
Bit of hygiene while doing release prep

* Latest 5 go versions for testing
* Updated actions

diff:
diff --git a/.github/workflows/ci.yml b/.github/workflows/ci.yml
index 03b0a99..3724f60 100644
--- a/.github/workflows/ci.yml
+++ b/.github/workflows/ci.yml
@@ -8,13 +8,13 @@ jobs:
     strategy:
       fail-fast: false
       matrix:
-        go: [ '1.20', '1.19', '1.18', '1.17', '1.16' ]
+        go: [ '1.26', '1.25', '1.24', '1.23', '1.22' ]
         os: [ ubuntu-latest, macOS-latest, windows-latest ]
     name: ${{ matrix.os }} Go ${{ matrix.go }} Tests
     steps:
-      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
+      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
       - name: Setup go
-        uses: actions/setup-go@v4
+        uses: actions/setup-go@v6
         with:
           go-version: ${{ matrix.go }}
       - run: go test
diff --git a/.github/workflows/codeql-analysis.yml b/.github/workflows/codeql-analysis.yml
index b5bab63..0fed7f4 100644
--- a/.github/workflows/codeql-analysis.yml
+++ b/.github/workflows/codeql-analysis.yml
@@ -38,11 +38,11 @@ jobs:
 
     steps:
     - name: Checkout repository
-      uses: actions/checkout@v4
+      uses: actions/checkout@v6
 
     # Initializes the CodeQL tools for scanning.
     - name: Initialize CodeQL
-      uses: github/codeql-action/init@v2
+      uses: github/codeql-action/init@v4
       with:
         languages: ${{ matrix.language }}
         # If you wish to specify custom queries, you can do so here or in a config file.
@@ -56,7 +56,7 @@ jobs:
     # Autobuild attempts to build any compiled languages  (C/C++, C#, or Java).
     # If this step fails, then you should remove it and run the build manually (see below)
     - name: Autobuild
-      uses: github/codeql-action/autobuild@v2
+      uses: github/codeql-action/autobuild@v4
 
     # ℹ️ Command-line programs to run using the OS shell.
     # 📚 See https://docs.github.com/en/actions/using-workflows/workflow-syntax-for-github-actions#jobsjob_idstepsrun
@@ -69,4 +69,4 @@ jobs:
     #   ./location_of_script_within_repo/buildscript.sh
 
     - name: Perform CodeQL Analysis
-      uses: github/codeql-action/analyze@v2
+      uses: github/codeql-action/analyze@v4
diff --git a/.github/workflows/release.yml b/.github/workflows/release.yml
index 15bf3f5..3318636 100644
--- a/.github/workflows/release.yml
+++ b/.github/workflows/release.yml
@@ -11,7 +11,7 @@ jobs:
     runs-on: ubuntu-latest
     steps:
       - name: Checkout code
-        uses: actions/checkout@v4
+        uses: actions/checkout@v6
       - name: Generate build files
         uses: thatisuday/go-cross-build@v1.0.2
         with:
diff --git a/.gitignore b/.gitignore
index e43b0f9..999f85c 100644
--- a/.gitignore
+++ b/.gitignore
@@ -1 +1,3 @@
 .DS_Store
+CLAUDE.md
+.claude
diff --git a/README.md b/README.md
index 5f7e27a..dc446ee 100644
--- a/README.md
+++ b/README.md
@@ -22,7 +22,6 @@ go get github.com/joho/godotenv
 
 or if you want to use it as a bin command
 
-go >= 1.17
 ```shell
 go install github.com/joho/godotenv/cmd/godotenv@latest
 ```

explanation.what: CI・リリース周りの棚卸し。ci.yml のテスト対象 Go バージョンを 1.16〜1.20 から 1.22〜1.26 に引き上げ、actions/checkout・setup-go・codeql-action を新しいメジャーバージョンに更新し、.gitignore に CLAUDE.md / .claude を追加、README から古い "go >= 1.17" の注記を削除した。
explanation.why: PR本文にある通り、リリース準備の一環としての整理("Bit of hygiene while doing release prep")。テスト対象 Go バージョンを最新5世代に揃え、依存アクションのメジャーバージョンも合わせて更新している。

highlights.note: テスト対象 Go バージョンを 1.16-1.20 から 1.22-1.26 へ
